programme.title: When the river rises
programme.desc: The story takes place in Tennessee. Despite the threat of a rising river and a poor harvest, Tom Garvey and his wife Mae, a young farming couple, are determined to preserve the land of their ancestors. But, burdened by debt, Tom is forced to become a scab during a strike at the local steel mill, leaving his wife to run the farm. Upon their return, they have to face not only the flooding of a furious river that can wash away the work of so many years but also a power-hungry landowner who covets the lands of the Garveys and their neighbors to satisfy his ambition.

programme.title: The skyscraper
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Will Sawyer was the head of the FBI's hostage rescue team. After a failed intervention with victims, Sawyer left his job at the FBI and now, married with two twin children, works evaluating the security of skyscrapers. On his trip to China for work, the police point him out as the sole culprit for the fire in the world's largest skyscraper, La Perla, because only he has unlimited access to the building's security system. Despite that, he manages to escape. While trying to capture the real culprits to prove his innocence, he must rescue his family who are trapped in the flames of the building and avoid being captured by the police. The objective of those responsible for the fire is to obtain compromised information that the owner of the building has.

programme.title: extreme chase

Already in the United States, he has to take action again when his wife is kidnapped by a bloodthirsty mafia gang led by the cruel Rome. With everything at stake, John will not stop until he completes his toughest and most important mission.

programme.title: The agent

programme.title: The source of life
programme.desc: An odyssey about a man's fight to save the woman he loves in three time spaces: the 21st century, the conquest of America, and the future.

programme.title: Cross-fire
programme.desc: After witnessing the brutal murder of a store owner and his son, firefighter Jeremy Coleman miraculously escapes with his life. Having witnessed the murders and being forced to testify against the gang of gangsters that carried them out, specifically against their leader, David Hagan, he is integrated into the witness protection program under the supervision of the Marshalls. Agent Talia will be in charge of protecting Jeremy's life from this cruel murderer. Inspector Mike Calla will be in charge of handling Coleman's case, a man who precisely lost his wife at the hands of the same gangster who committed this crime, and who since then has not stopped searching for him to do justice. The problem comes when Jeremy Coleman's new identity is compromised, so the firefighter is forced to take action to recover his life and save those of his loved ones.

programme.title: A doctor in the countryside
programme.desc: After 30 years working as the only doctor in a small village in a rural area of ​​southern France, Jean-Pierre falls ill. Health problems remove the doctor who treated, cured and cared for his neighbors from the profession 365 days a year and at any time. That is why it is necessary for another person to move in to replace him during sick leave. At that moment, Nathalie, a young doctor who has just finished her residency and who also has extensive experience as a nurse, arrives in the village. She will be in charge of helping Pierre with his work when he can't, but it will be a professional challenge because she has never worked in a medical office in a small town. In this way, it will also be complicated for Jean-Pierre because for him his work is the most important thing, so he will have to learn to deal with his new partner.

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: Frank is a criminal who, together with his companions, tries to rob a bank. However, the police end up being alerted and while trying to flee, a mysterious assailant hits Frank on the head, causing him to lose part of his memory. Rex, the leader of the gang, awaits answers about the failed robbery, while Frank will try to do everything possible to recover the 10 minutes that have disappeared from his memory and find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Contraband
programme.desc: Chris, a legendary smuggler, decided long ago to leave the world of crime. Now he will be forced to resume his activity to pay the debt of Andy, his brother-in-law, when he makes a mistake in a drug case, commissioned by his inflexible boss, Tim Briggs.

programme.title: 22 Balas
programme.desc: A former member of the mafia who has been retired for three years, living a peaceful life dedicated to his wife and children, is attacked one morning by men and left for dead after receiving 22 bullets. However, after miraculously surviving, he begins searching for Tony Zacchia, the only man capable of daring to kill him. Tony has made only one mistake: failing in his attempt...

programme.title: survive tonight
programme.desc: The home of a disgraced doctor is invaded by two criminals. One of them was shot during a robbery. Although the doctor tries to help him, his knowledge is insufficient to stop the bleeding. His only concern is to protect his family at all costs.

programme.title: die again
programme.desc: A former member of the American special forces, Roy, is forced to live the day of his death over and over again in a loop. He must find out who is responsible for this situation in order to end his hell.

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: Upon returning from a mission in Mombasa, elite soldier Ray Garrison and his wife are kidnapped and murdered. Shortly after, Ray awakens in the Spirit Reborn Project facility with no memory of his past.

programme.title: Mutiny on board
programme.desc: In 1787, the ship Bounty made a dangerous journey of 50,000 kilometers. After a month of sailing under strong storms, Captain William Bligh allows the crew to dock on a remote island so that they can rest. After seeing the situation of lack of control among the sailors, the captain insists on returning to the boat to continue his trip. However, the second in command, Fletcher Christian, will support his men.

programme.title: back to the future
programme.desc: Marty McFly is a teenager tired of his family. One day he receives a call from his friend Doc, a scientist whom everyone thinks is crazy, to show him his latest invention. It is a time machine that consists of a car powered by plutonium. Marty accidentally activates the machine, traveling back in time to 1955. In the past, Marty discovers his teenage parents and mistakenly avoids their first date. Marty must reunite his parents, convince Doc that he comes from the future and manage to travel back to the present. Initially, the role of Marty McFly was going to be played by Eric Stoltz. However, in the middle of filming, the directors fired Stoltz when they considered that he was not the right actor. Michael J. Fox, who had been an early choice, was committed to the show Family Ties at the time. However, after Stoltz's dismissal he was available to record the film and immediately accepted the role. Christopher Lloyd plays Doc. Lloyd initially turned down the role, but ultimately accepted it once he read the script. The film's director, Robert Zemeckis, along with the screenwriter, Bob Gale, had already been interested in the idea of ​​making a film about time travel. The final idea came after Gale reflected on the possibility of having become friends with his father if they had attended the same school. After Back to the Future, Robert Zemeckis directed other successful films such as Forrest Gump, Cast Away and Flight. The success of Back to the Future led to the production of a trilogy, as well as the creation of an animated series.

programme.title: Back to the future II
programme.desc: Marty, his girlfriend Jennifer and Doc travel to the future, to the year 2015, to prevent the couple's son from being imprisoned for a problem with the law. However, the presence of the temporary travelers will cause a bigger problem than the one they intended to fix and things will become increasingly complicated. The problem begins when Marty buys a sports almanac with all the results of the competitions up to the year 2000, in order to make easy money when he returns to the past. As in the first part, Marty McFly and Doc are played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. However, two of the actors from the first part, Crispin Glover and Claudia Wells, did not participate in the second part. Crispin Glover, who played Marty's father in the first part, was replaced by Jeffrey Weissman, who used facial prosthetics to look as much like Glover as possible. For her part, Elisabeth Shue was in charge of replacing Claudia Wells, who in the first part played Jennifer, Marty's girlfriend. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years spent building the sets and writing the script, filming began in February 1989. Without a doubt, the biggest challenge was creating the futuristic vision of Hill Valley. It should be noted that this second part and the third part of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker was abandoned by his parents when he was still a child, and was raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Somewhat marginalized at school, Peter wants to know his past and find out who he is, but there he meets his first love, Gwen Stacy. When Peter discovers a briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a search to learn how his parents disappeared, something that will take him to Oscorp and the laboratory of his father's former partner, Dr. Connor, where he is bitten by an experimentally modified spider that gives him incredible powers. The murder of his uncle by a thief will make him seek revenge, catching the criminals he finds in his path, so he realizes that his destiny is to help people. But Dr. Connor, in turn, is forced to test his own experiment (a lizard serum that regenerates body limbs) on himself after his dismissal, which turns him into The Lizard. This will spread panic among the citizens, and Peter will be forced to use his powers. It is the first film of a cinematographic reboot of this character, since due to script problems Sony had canceled the fourth installment of Spider-Man, opting for this reboot. Marc Webb is in charge of directing the film, and he specializes in the world of music videos, in which groups such as Green Day, My Chemical Romance, Evanescence, Maroon 5 and Fergie have featured him. His only films are (500) Days Together and the first and second installment of this new Spider-Man saga. Andrew Garfield plays Peter Parker. He began in theater and acted in Leones por Corderos and the television film Boy A, which gave him recognition; just like his performance in The Social Network. Emma Stone plays Gwen Stacy, and participated in films such as Campus Bunny, Ghosts of My Ex-Girlfriends, Crazy, Stupid, Love or Entitled to Friction. His role in Easy A earned him a Golden Globe nomination.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2: El poder de Electro
programme.desc: Peter Parker leads a very busy life: he has to save the city from bad guys and also continue with his university life to take care of Gwen, although from a distance. Things get complicated when the villain Electro appears with a thirst for revenge. However, it won't be the only thing Peter has to face, as the return of an old friend, Harry Osborn, brings new clues about his past.

programme.title: Yo, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Two hundred years after his creation, the well-known Dr. Frankenstein's creature, Adam, survives in a dark and violent city where a war has broken out between the human species and immortal beings. In the midst of the conflict, Adam discovers that on both sides there are two immortal clans that are in conflict and that he has the key to destroying the human race.

programme.title: The seventh son
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Master Gregory captured the evil and powerful witch Malkin. But the witch managed to escape and prepares her revenge. Meanwhile, Master Gregory sets out to teach his young apprentice Tom Ward to fight black magic in record time.

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: 19th century. Human beings are stalked by terrifying monsters that have survived throughout the centuries, generation after generation. The mythical monster hunter Van Helsing is tasked with defeating the seductive, mysterious and powerful Count Dracula. To do this he must travel to the enigmatic and dark Transylvania.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, commander of the team, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Siege status
programme.desc: Third collaboration between director Edward Zwick and Denzel Washington after "Glory Times (1989)" where he won his first Oscar for Best Supporting Actor and "In Honor of the Truth" (1996) and magnificent hand in hand full of tension between Denzel Washington and Bruce Willis. New York City becomes the target of a wave of terrorist attacks. FBI agent Anthony Hubbard (Denzel Washington) is appointed head of the joint anti-terrorist force and together with CIA agent Elise Kraft (Annette Bening), with important contacts in the Arab-American community, they will be in charge of arresting those responsible. Meanwhile, the government declares martial law and sends General William Deveraux (Bruce Willis) to command the troops tasked with occupying the city.

programme.title: Target: The White House
programme.desc: Secret Service Agent Mike Banning is assigned to desk duty at the Federal Reserve after saving the life of US President Asher Benjamin in a car accident. However, he was unable to rescue the First Lady. A year later, a North Korean commando led by a terrorist named Kang carries out an attack on Washington and manages to capture President Asher and his cabinet, holding them hostage in the White House bunker itself. It's a desperate situation and Mike will have to take responsibility for the rescue.

programme.title: Conan the destroyer
programme.desc: Queen Taramis entrusts Conan with a very dangerous mission: to accompany Princess Jehnna on a long journey for which she was born predestined. Their objective is to recover a jewel that is in the possession of a powerful sorcerer. If he succeeds, the queen promises that she will help him recover Valeria, his great love. But the monarch's intentions are very different since with the jewel she wants to bring an ancient god back to life.

programme.title: sealed chamber
programme.desc: Having survived the hatred and intolerance inherited from his grandfather, young lawyer Adam Hall seeks at the last minute to appeal the old man's death sentence for a crime committed thirty years ago in which he is accused of murdering two young Jewish children. Just four weeks before Sam Cayhall is executed, Adam finds himself for the first time in the Mississippi prison where he has been since the crime. The meeting is visibly tense when the young man faces the insults that the old man says, but when he leaves prison and sees that the press has published in big headlines that he intends to save his grandfather, things begin to get complicated. Ron Howard was the original director of the film, but left the project to focus on 'Rescue'. Even so, he remained as executive producer. At the same time, Brad Pitt was offered to star in the film but he was busy making 'Rescue'. William Goldman, who wrote the first scripts, was very disappointed with the changes made to his sketches and never saw the finished film.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Frank Morris, a prisoner specialized in escapes with a very high intelligence quotient, is imprisoned in Alcatraz prison. In his head he keeps preparing an escape plan that will not be without risks.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Matilda Wormwood is an extraordinary child, but her parents' ignorance prevents them from seeing their daughter's abilities. When she starts school she discovers that the students live under the dictatorship of Principal Trunchbull. Only Professor Honey will be able to discover his potential.

programme.title: stomping
programme.desc: Retired from the United States Army Special Forces, Chris Vaughn returns to his hometown eager to pick up his life where he left off. But time has made his home a dangerous place, as his high school rival, Jay Hamilton, has put the town at the service of crime. After being elected sheriff, Chris vows to restore peace.

programme.title: Red hot
programme.desc: Art Jeffries is an FBI agent with respect problems for his superiors. One day he is assigned to investigate the case of a missing boy, Simon, whose parents have been murdered. After finding him, he discovers that he is a nine-year-old autistic boy with a prodigious ability to reveal supposedly insurmountable government codes.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker is a shy young student. He has never had much confidence in himself and although he is very intelligent, except for his best friend, the rich Harry Osborn, he has no friends. He has been in love with his beautiful redhead neighbor for years: Mary Jane, but he would never find the courage to propose to her. Meanwhile, he lives in a small neighborhood in the New York borough of Queens with his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. His life will change forever when, during a visit to a laboratory, a radioactive spider bites him, causing changes in him that at first seem frightening but will soon make him feel as if he had spider superpowers: he has colossal strength, he can climb walls and ceilings and he can also create spider webs with his hands. With his new powers, Peter becomes more daring. He no longer needs glasses and has acquired muscles that make him very attractive. At school he saves Mary Jane from falling in the cafeteria and accidentally throws food at a bully named "Flash." When he is about to hit him, Peter manages to neutralize him and impresses his friends and the girl of his dreams. To try to win him over, she lies to her Uncle Ben by saying she is going to the library but actually entering a wrestling contest for $3,000. With the money he intends to buy a second-hand sports car for Mary Jane. But when he wins the fight he discovers that the manager does not intend to pay him. Snubbed, he goes out to the street to find his uncle dying on the ground: a thief has shot him to take the car. In his arms, the one who was like a father to him dies. Peter will now become "Spiderman" and use a costume to take revenge on criminals who destroy families like his. Soon his first enemy will appear: The Green Goblin. The Green Goblin was chosen as the villain of this film since director Sam Raimi felt that the father-son duel would make the film more interesting.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Two years ago Peter Parker decided to accept his responsibility as Spider-Man and put his personal life aside; within which enter his great love Mary Jane Watson and his friend Harry Osborn, who feels a desire for revenge against Spider-Man for the death of his father. Peter's relationship with both of them is increasingly deteriorating. Peter's friend and role model, Dr. Otto Octavius ​​begins experimenting with fusion energy funded by the current president of Oscorp, who is Harry Osborn. But accidentally, the experiment becomes unstable, so his robotic arms fuse to his spine and he loses control, becoming the villainous Dr. Octopus. Despite this conflict with Octavius, Peter faces the emotional distress caused by knowing that his love Mary Jane is engaged to another man. This makes him think about what his life would be like without having to fight crime, so he will be forced to choose between his personal life as a student and his public obligations. Directed by Sam Raimi, it is the second film in the Marvel superhero saga made by this director, who is also known for his low-budget horror films such as "The Evil Dead" trilogy. He also produced television series such as "Hercules: His Legendary Journeys" or "Xena: Warrior Princess." Tobey Maguire plays Peter Parker in this first Spider-Man trilogy, who made his film debut with "This Boy's Life" and starred in films such as "Pleasantville", "Seabiscuit" and "The Great Gatsby". Kirsten Dunst plays Mary Jane Watson. This actress, model and singer was recognized at the age of 12 for her portrayal of a vampire in "Interview with the Vampire." He also participated in "Jumanji", "The Virgin Suicides" by Sofia Coppola and "Marie Antoinette". James Franco plays Harry Osborn, who began in the series "Freaks & Geeks" and participated in films such as "Milk" or "127 Hours."

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: Peter Parker and Mary Jane are finally together. They have both been able to accept their feelings and start a relationship. Mary Jane has landed a great role on Broadway and Peter continues to put on the Spiderman suit, helping those in need and capturing the city's criminals. Life seems to smile at them, even though their friend Harry continues to blame Peter for his father's death. But this is not the only threat that looms over the protagonists. An alien entity with symbiotic and violent behavior has arrived on Earth. Peter comes into contact with it, but even though his powers seem to increase when it envelops him, Peter realizes the dangers it poses and gets rid of it. The alien possesses Eddie Brocks, giving rise to a new and feared villain called Venom. At the same time, another villain begins to operate in the city, Sandman. Finally, Venom and Sandman kidnap Mary Jane and Spiderman must save her with the help of an unexpected ally. Director Sam Raimi was against the appearance of the Venom character in his film due to the character's lack of humanity. But producer Avi Arad convinced him that he had a large group of followers who read his stories in the Spider-Man comics and that he should appear. Topher Grace's performance definitely convinced him of Venom's appearance in this third installment of the saga. It took three years to realize the special effects related to Sandman's powers, many experiments were carried out to analyze the behavior of the sand and digitally imitate it on the big screen.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious (A todo gas)
programme.desc: FBI agent Brian O'Conner investigates a case of highway robberies from sports vehicles. To obtain information, he enters the world of illegal racing and infiltrates the gang led by Dominic Torreto, the main suspect. Everything will become even more complicated when he falls in love with his little sister, Mia.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious (A todo gas 2)
programme.desc: After botching an important investigation into illegal nighttime racing in Los Angeles due to his addiction to speed, Agent Brian O'Connor is tasked with arresting Carter Verone, a Miami businessman who uses his import-export business to launder money. To do this, he must infiltrate the clandestine racing drivers again.

programme.title: Yo, Robot
programme.desc: Set in a future earth (2035 A.D.) where robots are common assistants and workers for humans, their owners, this story tells of the "robophobia" of a Chicago police detective who believes that a robot was involved in the murder of Dr. Alfred Lanning. Even though everyone considers it crazy, the detective keeps finding clues that point to the doctor's metal assistant as the only culprit. But if that is so, that would imply that the three laws of robotics have been violated, something completely impossible. Because if robots could destroy those laws, no one would stop them from taking over the world... For the role of Sonny, the accused robot, the special effects team used the same process that was used with Gollum in 'The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers', with Alan Tudyk providing the movements and voice for Sonny.

According to the Mayan calendar, the year 2012 is set as the date of the end of the world. This end of the world will bring different natural disasters, volcanoes will erupt, there will be major floods, typhoons... Jackson Curtis (John Cusack) is a writer of science fiction stories who also works as a driver for a Russian millionaire. Jackson is divorced and has two children, Lilly (Morgan Lily) and Noah (Liam James) who live with his ex-wife's boyfriend. One day, when Jackson and his children return home they find that great seismic activity is affecting the entire West Coast of the United States. Suddenly the Curtis family will find themselves immersed in a fight to survive what could be the end of the world. Actor John Cusack, known for his performance in films such as '1408' (2007), 'High Fidelity' (2000) or 'How to Be John Malkovich' (1999), stars in this feature film about the consequences of the end of the world that the Mayans predicted would happen in 2012. Its director, Roland Emmerich, specialized in action films and apocalyptic and disaster films, confirmed the film's completion. of a television series, a sequel to the feature film, which would be based on the survivors of the disaster. An alternative ending to the film was also included in some versions of the DVD marketed in different countries. For its promotion, a trailer was used in which you could see how a tsunami threatened the Himalayas, ending with the phrase 'The governments of the world did not prepare the people for the end of the world, find out the truth.' The page of the fictitious organization 'Institute for Human Continuity' was also launched, thus beginning an important viral marketing strategy.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: China can build a robot that runs faster than Usain Bolt. So why can't it reliably empty a dishwasher? We explore the gap between what AI can think and what robots can actually do. As viral clips from Beijing's World Humanoid Robot Games showcase astonishing feats and spectacular failures, we ask whether China is leading a robotics revolution or exposing the limits of today's technology. Christian Fraser and Priya Lakhani are joined by Oxford Robotics Institute founder Professor Ingmar Posner and Laelaps AI co-founder Maria Stamatopoulou to examine why building a robot body is getting easier, but building a robot mind remains one of AI's greatest challenges.

Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths visits a company building sustainable electric vehicle tech, which doesn't rely on rare earths. Ammie Sekhon meets the comedian who has created an AI of himself to see if it's better at comedy than he is. And Lara Lewington finds out why Kew Wakehurst botanic garden has become a living laboratory.

programme.title: Streets of Gold: Mumbai
programme.desc: Indian weddings normally take place over several days, and as part of his wedding preparations, Nikhil is preparing his ceremony of haldi - Hindi for turmeric. A turmeric paste is smeared on the groom by the women in his family. The ceremony signifies purity, prosperity and fertility. Nikhil and his bride-to-be Prarthana's wedding is a £30,000 extravaganza financed solely by the groom. With the main rituals completed, it's time for the Marathi tradition, in which the bride's family can demand a ransom to release her. 'We want cash!', shout the bridesmaids. The business of love is booming in Mumbai. Derby Day is an annual event at the iconic Mahalaxmi Racecourse in Mumbai. It is India's most glamorous horse race and combines high-society fashion, food, music and elite thoroughbred racing. We learn that Anupam Mittal, the entrepreneur, has skin in the game, and his horse Democracy is one of the favourites for a race in this year's Indian Derby weekend. However, it's not a good day for Democracy - she comes second to last. But it's a better day for Aradhana, the former air steward and aspiring actress from Delhi who lands a job cohosting online TV coverage of the Derby.

programme.title: Abandoned: Searching for Soldier Dad
programme.desc: DNA detectives track down the British soldiers who fathered children in Kenya then disappeared, leaving the children and their mothers without support. It's a quest to find a missing part of the children's identities. With access to every stage of this cutting-edge process, we follow as a team of lawyers and a leading geneticist travel to Kenya to help locate the British soldiers who fathered children then vanished. We witness the groundbreaking legal and scientific detective work used to find the missing dads. Lawyers believe British soldiers stationed at the army base in Nanyuki, Kenya, may have fathered hundreds of children over decades - the oldest we meet is now 70, the youngest just 18 months old. What's at stake is more than the reputation of the British army and the UK's post-colonial legacy. The mixed-heritage children have in some cases been ostracised by their communities and denied a chance of British citizenship since birth - something which could transform their lives.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: It's a landmark year for Poland's Baltic coast as the maritime city of Gdynia celebrates its 100th birthday. Gdynia sits on a stretch of coastline some call the Polish Riviera, and it's become increasingly popular as some holidaymakers search for less crowded and cooler alternatives to the hot and busy Mediterranean resorts. Reece Parkinson meets a new generation drawn to the maritime traditions of Gdynia, sees the remarkable revival of Gdańsk's shipyards and experiences the wild windswept beaches of the Hel Peninsula.

programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. Ia berusaha mendapatkan teman di sekolah barunya sebelum perkemahan musim gugur sekolah dimulai, tetapi ternyata hal itu lebih sulit dari yang dibayangkannya. Di rumah, ia berteman dengan seekor tikus kecil yang tinggal di kamar barunya, yang ia beri nama Peepeep. Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: It looks like a Ferrari, but comes from the Lower Bavarian province: the Glas GT. Uwe Gusen is one of the few who are still interested in the Glas brand - because it is racing at full speed into oblivion. If you want to buy one, you should hurry up and know your way around. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In this episode of Top Speed, presenter Martin Utberg welcomes Gundbert Schall and Ralf Stöckler to the VAYA Hotel in Seefeld in Tyrol, where manager Jens Beine takes the trio into the kitchen to prepare a dish together. It's not entirely a coincidence that Jens and the two guests already played a role in previous Top Speed ​​episodes, which we look back on here. Behind the wheel of his Porsche Targa, Gundbert talks about the Swabian Alb Mountain Prize in Neuffen, a classic car event that attracts more than 20,000 visitors every year. Last year, Martin also covered the 4.2 kilometer route in a racing car and be (channel information).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Bentley and the 24 Hours of LeMans: The legendary Bentley Boys won the endurance classic five times between 1924 and 1930. The Hazadeurs often traveled in their own cars, mounted the racing tires and drove for victory. Then we went home under our own steam. It's an idea that Bentley revived in 2001. And: The Chrysler C-300 in the classic check. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In 1964, the tractor manufacturer Ferruccio Lamborghini decided to build the best sports cars in the world in the tranquil town of SantAgata Bolognese - a bold undertaking here, in the northern Italian province of Bologna, just a few kilometers from Ferrari. This episode of CAR HISTORY is all about the legend of Ferruccio Lamborghini and the roots of his noble forge with the fighting bull: the icon of Italian automotive technology. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: 1983 – Audi brings the Quattro drive and with it a new dimension to rally racing. The races are getting harder and more brutal. Drivers, vehicles and mechanics are increasingly being pushed beyond their limits. The rally cars with the four rings from Ingolstadt are hard to beat during this time and race from victory to victory. (Station info).

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: The Nürburgring: Racing drivers from all over the world have been trying to set records here since the 1930s. Among them was Sabine Schmitz – a racing driver with heart and soul. In 1996 and 97 she won the annual classic '24 Hours'. And even today she still has a strong say when it comes to a place on the winner's podium in important races on the Ring. (Station info).

programme.sub-title: 25 years of the fall of the Berlin Wall – that’s how mobile the East was
programme.desc: Anyone who thinks in the socialist East there were only two-stroke engines that smelled of oil like the Wartburg and Trabant, or outdated licensed buildings like Lada, is wrong. Companies such as Tatra from Czechoslovakia produced progressive, even groundbreaking automobiles in the 1950s. Unfortunately, the customer base remained exclusive, and hardly any of the rear-engined streamlined cars found their way to the West. Today these cars are cult and interesting collector's items. Classic Ride introduces a few enthusiasts and their extraordinary Tatra vehicles. (Station info).
